description: CER - Small-scale Installations - Solar Water Heater - Heat Pump (POA) 2001-Jun 2021 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Clean Energy Regulator. This dataset presents the footprint of the number of installations of solar water heater (SWH) air source heat pump systems. The data spans the months from January 2020 to June 2021 and includes the total over the months from 2001 to 2019. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Clean Energy Regulator. Its tags are BUILT ENVIRONMENT AND DESIGN, Climate change science, Climate change science not elsewhere classified, Design, EARTH SCIENCES. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
